dedupe_keys.name: madrid regional transport consortium open data gtfs network elements and transport zonings

description: The open data portal of the Madrid Regional Transport Consortium publishes the public transport network of the Community of Madrid. It holds GTFS timetables for six networks (Metro, Metro Ligero and tram, Cercanías commuter rail, EMT Madrid city buses, other urban buses and interurban buses); layers of network elements for each network (stations, accesses, halls, platforms, stops by itinerary and itineraries); transport zonings used by the regional household mobility surveys (1,259 and 208 zones of EDM 2018, 84 zones of EDM 2018 and ESM 2014, 1,172 zones of EDM 2004); fare rings; park-and-ride car parks; transport card offices and sales points; and 24 Rutas Verdes walking and cycling routes. CRTM is the public transport authority of the Community of Madrid. The portal lists 48 items as GTFS CSV collections, ArcGIS feature services and KML files, free to download. Reuse, commercial or not, is allowed under CRTM's static open data licence under Spanish Law 37/2007: CRTM must be cited, digital products must show "Powered by CRTM" with a link, information shown must be kept up to date, and raw data shared must keep the same licence. Caveats: the Metro GTFS dates from May 2025 and the Cercanías GTFS from August 2024 while the bus feeds were updated in July 2026, and the survey trip matrices are not on the portal. The data support network flow, capacity planning and agent-based studies of Madrid's public transport, and follow the GTFS specification catalogued here.
